textual.context: Presented as promotional event content attributed to Bybit and promoted through the video description; the source does not independently establish whether the event, rewards, or linked destination are genuine or available.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised rewards and lottery chances are explicitly linked to account creation through a supplied link, a minimum cryptocurrency deposit, and trading activity, creating a reward-for-action and money-flow relationship requiring later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish that viewers paid, received rewards, won prizes, or experienced loss. They do not verify the links, Bybit affiliation, event terms, eligibility, or outcomes.

visual.potential_relevance: A promised benefit and lucky-draw opportunity are explicitly linked to registering an account and, in the displayed offer, depositing $100, creating a reward-to-action relationship that may merit review.
visual.limitations: These frames do not establish whether the offer was fulfilled, whether funds were transferred, or whether the displayed website, promotion, or outcomes were verified.

visual.observation: The displayed event advertises prizes including 1 BTC, 1 ETH, a Rolex, AirPods Pro 2, and a Tesla Model 3, while also showing a referral code overlay and a "Register Now" control.
visual.context: Visible event-promotion page; the relationship between the referral code and eligibility is not fully explained in the sampled frames.
visual.potential_relevance: High-value prize claims are presented alongside registration and a referral-code prompt, linking the advertised rewards to audience action and referral-related participation.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show the full eligibility terms, whether referral use is required, or whether any prize was actually awarded.

visual.observation: A rewards page states that users can collect crypto cards to generate tickets, and shows a daily prize pool of 3,000 USDT with ticket counts and a lucky-draw interface displaying remaining tickets.
visual.context: Visible rewards and lucky-draw interface within the promoted crypto event.
visual.potential_relevance: The stated prize pool and draw participation are linked to collecting crypto cards and generating tickets, creating a conditional reward mechanism that may merit review.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show how cards are obtained, whether obtaining them requires payment or transfer, or whether the displayed prize pool or draw results are genuine.

A separate purchase interface visibly shows buying 100 USDT using a bank-transfer payment method, including a confirmation step.
